Expertise & research interests

Economic analysis
and quantitative methods.

I use applied economics and quantitative analysis to study development questions. Communicating the findings is also part of my work.

01

Economics & development

I start with an economic question and build the analysis around it, taking the sector and its institutional context into account.

  • Structural transformation & sector pathways
  • Agriculture & food security
  • Literature reviews & policy synthesis
02

Data & econometrics

I construct indicators and check the properties of the data before analysing the findings. I also explain the limits of the interpretation.

  • Cleaning, structuring & quality checks
  • Panel data & diagnostics in Stata
  • Tables, visualisation & reporting
03

Finance, AI & digital

I study changes in production and learn to use new analytical tools, particularly in finance, digital technologies and AI.

  • Financial development & sector productivity
  • ICT adoption & productive transformation
  • AI as research support, with human verification
